name: United Arab Emirates
blurb: Record-breaking skylines, desert safaris and luxury beaches.
cities: Dubai
Skyscrapers, mega-malls, beach clubs and desert safaris.
Abu Dhabi
Grand mosque, Louvre Abu Dhabi and calm beaches.
Ras Al Khaimah
Mountain zip lines and quieter beaches.
Sharjah
Museums and a restored heritage quarter.
Al Ain
Oasis palm groves, mud-brick forts and Bronze Age tombs on the edge of the desert.
Faya Palaeolandscape
Rock shelters in the Sharjah desert used by Stone Age people for 200,000 years.
Wadi Wurayah
Mountain pools and a rare waterfall in a protected wadi of the Hajar range.
Ajman
Quiet beaches, the Ajman Museum in an 18th-century fort and a growing marina.
Umm Al Quwain
Mangrove kayaking, an old fort and a laid-back lagoon town.
Fujairah & the East Coast
Fujairah Fort, the Al Bidya Mosque and snorkelling off Snoopy Island on the Gulf of Oman.
Hatta
A mountain exclave of Dubai with a dam lake for kayaking and a heritage village.
Jebel Jais
The UAE's highest peak, with a mountain road, viewing decks and the world's longest zipline.
Liwa Oasis & the Empty Quarter
Date-palm oases at the edge of the Empty Quarter, with the towering Moreeb Dune and desert camps.
Sir Bani Yas Island
An island wildlife reserve with cheetahs, giraffes and Arabian oryx, plus quiet beaches.
Khor Fakkan
A Gulf of Oman beach town with a waterfall, an old fort and a mountain road through the Hajar range.
